description: Shared UTF-16 runtime contract with the complete supplied multilingual reference retained for transparent gap tracking.
surface_contract: Runtime sentence is the displayed processed string after tokenizer input normalization and character substitutions. Offsets and surface spans address this displayed sentence, never raw input. reference_suite retains original raw-source intent.

reference_suite.description: Comprehensive 44-language tokenization, normalization, and lemmatization test suite for language-learning applications.

global_pipeline_requirements.unicode_normalization: Always normalize raw input to NFC before UI rendering and tokenization so decomposed characters (e.g., macOS/iOS NFD Hangul Jamo or Vietnamese stacked diacritics) do not split mid-grapheme. Note: NFC canonically decomposes the precomposed nukta letters of Devanagari (U+0958..U+095F) and Bengali (U+09DC, U+09DD, U+09DF) into base + nukta, so treat the nukta (U+093C / U+09BC) as a combining mark inside words.
global_pipeline_requirements.apostrophe_unification: Fold typographic apostrophes (U+2019 ’, U+02BC ʼ, U+02B9 ʹ) to ASCII apostrophe (U+0027 ') only when computing lookup_key and when deciding clitic splits; surface_span is never rewritten. Preserve Hebrew Gershayim (U+05F4) and Geresh (U+05F3).
global_pipeline_requirements.zero_width_characters: Preserve Zero-Width Joiner (ZWJ U+200D) and Zero-Width Non-Joiner (ZWNJ U+200C) inside tokens for Indic, Persian, and Urdu scripts; never treat them as whitespace boundaries.

field_definitions.tokens: Ordered list of clickable spans in reading order. One entry per span; a span may contain internal spaces (e.g., Việt Nam, rock 'n' roll) when it maps to one dictionary unit.
field_definitions.surface_span: Exact character slice of `sentence` (sentence[start:end] == surface_span), never normalized or rewritten, so UI highlight offsets cannot drift.
field_definitions.start_end: Unicode code-point offsets into `sentence`; start inclusive, end exclusive.
field_definitions.lookup_key: Index key for the span: locale-aware lowercasing, apostrophe folding to ASCII, and stripping of the optional marks listed in the language's strip_for_lookup. No digit-script conversion and no separator removal.
field_definitions.lemmas: Dictionary headwords for the span. One entry for a simple word; several entries when one span expands to several words (Dámelo → dar, me, lo; Isn’t → be, not; 学生들 → 학생, 들). A many-to-one phrase is a single span with its own lemma.
field_definitions.ignored_punctuation: Punctuation marks present in the sentence that are not part of any span and must not be clickable.

global_pipeline_requirements.number_grouping: CLDR group separators are U+00A0 (U+202F for French since CLDR 34), but real-world text often uses an ASCII space. A tokenizer needs a number-grouping pass so '1 500,50' (ASCII, NBSP or NNBSP) stays one span. Number parsing (digit-script conversion, separator removal) is out of scope for lookup_key.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Requires dictionary-based or ML word segmentation (e.g., ICU/PyThaiNLP). Keep Paiyannoi (ฯ) attached to abbreviated proper nouns. Normalize Sara Am (U+0E33) vs Nikhahit + Sara Aa (U+0E4D U+0E32).

tests.sentence: ฉันชอบอ่านหนังสือที่กรุงเทพฯ

lemmas: กรุงเทพมหานคร

tests.sentence: น้ำดื่มสะอาดอยู่ที่ออฟฟิศชั้น ๒

normalization_rules.special_notes: Must resolve overlapping ambiguity chains (garden-path compounds) and keep Erhua suffix (儿) attached when lexicalized.

tests.sentence: 乒乓球拍卖完了，只剩一点儿。
学而时习之，不亦说乎？

normalization_rules.special_notes: Requires morphological analysis (e.g., MeCab/Kuromoji/Sudachi) to separate hiragana particles from all-hiragana nouns and de-inflect agglutinated verb chains. Learner-facing policy: a predicate chain such as 行かなければならない is kept as one span with lemmas [行く, なければならない]; raw morphological analyzers (MeCab/Sudachi) split it into several morphemes.

tests.sentence: すもももももももものうち。
彼女は「東京へ行かなければならない」と言った。

tokens.surface_span: 行かなければならない
tokens.lookup_key: 行かなければならない

languages.name: Hindi
languages.group: Group 2: Complex Orthography & Zero-Width Joiners (Indic Scripts)

normalization_rules.special_notes: Note that Unicode NFC Canonical Composition deliberately decomposes precomposed Devanagari Nukta letters (e.g., क़ U+0958 -> क U+0915 + ़ U+093C). Tokenizer regex must include combining marks [\u0900-\u0963\u0966-\u096F\u0971-\u097F\u200C\u200D] inside word characters. The class deliberately excludes danda U+0964, double danda U+0965 and abbreviation sign U+0970 so they are not glued onto words.

tests.sentence: ग़ज़ल में ख़ास लफ़्ज़ हैं।
श्रीमान् ने क्‌ष और क्ष का अंतर बताया॥

languages.name: Bengali
languages.group: Group 2: Complex Orthography & Zero-Width Joiners (Indic Scripts)

normalization_rules.special_notes: Preserve ZWJ (U+200D) and ZWNJ (U+200C) inside words (e.g., Ra + ZWJ + Hasanta + Ya for Ya-phala in loanwords). Do not split on Nukta (U+09BC) or Khanda Ta (ৎ U+09CE).

tests.sentence: র‍্যাব ও র‌্যাব কি এক?
আষাঢ় মাসে প্রচুর বৃষ্টি হয়।

languages.name: Tamil
languages.group: Group 2: Complex Orthography & Zero-Width Joiners (Indic Scripts)

normalization_rules.special_notes: Keep two-part dependent vowel signs (e.g., ொ U+0BCA, ோ U+0BCB, ௌ U+0BCC), Aytham (ஃ U+0B83), Pulli (் U+0BCD), and multi-codepoint Grantha ligatures (க்ஷ, ஸ்ரீ) intact.

tests.sentence: அஃது தமிழ் மொழியின் சிறப்பு!
க்ஷத்ரியர் மற்றும் ஸ்ரீநிவாசன் வந்தனர்.

languages.name: Arabic
languages.group: Group 3: Right-to-Left (RTL) Scripts with Tashkeel / Harakat & Joiners

normalization_rules.special_notes: Strip Tashkeel/Harakat (U+064B..U+065F), Superscript Alef (U+0670), and Tatweel/Kashida (U+0640) for dictionary lookup. Keep clitic prefixes (و، ف، ب، ل، ك، ال) attached in surface_tokens to preserve cursive joining, but resolve to base lemma in dictionary_lemmas.

tests.sentence: هَلْ ذَهَبْتَ إِلَى الْمَكْتَبَةِ الْيَوْمَ؟
أَطْلَقَتْ شَرِكَةُ OpenAI نُسْخَةَ 2026 وَقَالَتْ: «مَرْحَبًا!»

languages.name: Persian (Farsi)
languages.group: Group 3: Right-to-Left (RTL) Scripts with Tashkeel / Harakat & Joiners

normalization_rules.special_notes: Normalize Arabic Yeh (ي U+064A) to Persian Yeh (ی U+06CC) and Arabic Kaf (ك U+0643) to Persian Kaf (ک U+06A9). Preserve ZWNJ (U+200C) inside compound nouns, plurals (ـ‌ها), and verbal prefixes (می‌). U+0654 (hamza above, the written ezāfe on final ه) is stripped for lookup so خانهٔ matches خانه; kasra (U+0650) is an optional vowel mark and is stripped too.

tests.sentence: من به کتاب‌خانه‌های بزرگ می‌روم؟
او ۴۵٬۰۰۰ ریال برایِ خانهٔ نو داد.

languages.name: Hebrew
languages.group: Group 3: Right-to-Left (RTL) Scripts with Tashkeel / Harakat & Joiners

normalization_rules.special_notes: Strip Niqqud and cantillation marks for lookup. Keep Gershayim (״ U+05F4) and ASCII quote (") inside acronyms (צה״ל). Split on Hebrew Maqaf (־ U+05BE).

tests.sentence: הַאִם קָרָאתָ אֶת הַדּוּ״חַ שֶׁל צה״ל בְּ־2026?
חברת Apple מכרה 1,500 מכשירים בת״א.

languages.name: Urdu
languages.group: Group 3: Right-to-Left (RTL) Scripts with Tashkeel / Harakat & Joiners

normalization_rules.special_notes: Distinguish Gol Heh (ہ U+06C1), Do-Chashmi Heh (ھ U+06BE for aspiration), and Arabic Heh (ه U+0647). Preserve ZWNJ (U+200C) in compounds and future auxiliaries. Treat Urdu full stop (۔ U+06D4) as sentence punctuation.

tests.sentence: کیا آپ کل اسلام‌آباد جائیں‌گے؟
اُس نے کہا: ”پڑھائی مکمل ہوئی۔“

normalization_rules.special_notes: Split proclitic elisions (c', d', j', l', m', n', qu', s', t', jusqu', lorsqu', puisqu', quoiqu') keeping the apostrophe on the clitic, EXCEPT in lexicalized dictionary entries (aujourd'hui, d'accord, quelqu'un, entr'acte, presqu'île).

tests.sentence: C'est aujourd'hui l'anniversaire d'Anne, d'accord ?
Qu'est-ce qu'il a vu dans cet œuf-là ?
Il a payé 12 500,75 € hier.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Distinguish proclitic elisions that split before a vowel (l', un', d', c', nell', quell', qualcos') from trailing apocopated apostrophes that belong to the preceding word (po' < poco, va', fa', da', sta').

tests.sentence: C'è un po' d'acqua nell'ombra per qualcos'altro.
Dà un'occhiata a quell'albero laggiù!

normalization_rules.special_notes: Never split on the middle dot / punt volat (· U+00B7) inside l·l (ela geminada). Reject deprecated Unicode compatibility characters Ŀ (U+013F) and ŀ (U+0140) in favor of l + U+00B7 + l. Split proclitic (l', d', n', s', m') and enclitic ('m, 't, 'l, 'ls, 'ns, 'n, -ho, -nos) weak pronouns. U+00B7 is part of a Catalan word only between two l letters (l·l); do not confuse it with Greek Ano Teleia, which NFC also maps to U+00B7.

tests.sentence: L'home d'un poble veí té una col·lecció d'art.
Dona'm-ho i anem-nos-en a l'escola!

normalization_rules.special_notes: Keep leading apostrophe attached to the indefinite article 'n (U+0027 + n or deprecated U+0149 ŉ). Note that at the start of a sentence, 'n remains lowercase and the following word is capitalized.

tests.sentence: 'n Man het 'n boek oor Suid-Afrikaanse voëls gelees.
Ons eet môreoggend 'n bietjie vroeg.

normalization_rules.special_notes: CRITICAL: Never use locale-unaware .toLowerCase() or .toUpperCase(). In Turkish, uppercase İ (U+0130) lowercases to i (U+0069), and uppercase I (U+0049) lowercases to dotless ı (U+0131). Keep apostrophes inside inflected proper nouns (İstanbul'daki) intact as a single surface token, or strip the case suffix after the apostrophe for lemma lookup.

tests.sentence: İSTANBUL'DAKİ IŞIKLAR İLKBAHARDA ÇOK GÜZELDİR.
Diyarbakır'ın ılık rüzgârı dün geceydi.

normalization_rules.special_notes: ß (U+00DF) and capital ẞ (U+1E9E) map to each other under lowercase/uppercase, while full case folding maps ß to ss and uppercase SS cannot be reliably mapped back to ß; fold to ss for lookup and keep the original spelling for display. Support compound decompounding for long German nouns so learners can look up both the full compound and constituent roots.

tests.sentence: Auf der großen Straße aßen wir Süßigkeiten.
Das Rindfleischetikettierungsüberwachungsaufgabenübertragungsgesetz gilt für Bäcker.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Uppercase Σ (U+03A3) must lowercase to medial σ (U+03C3) inside a word and final ς (U+03C2) at the end of a word. NFC maps precomposed oxia letters (e.g., U+1F71) to their tonos equivalents (e.g., ά U+03AC); the spacing marks U+0384 and U+1FFD are not unified by NFC. NFC converts Ano Teleia (U+0387) to U+00B7 and the Greek question mark (U+037E) to ASCII ';', so after NFC treat ';' at the end of a clause and a spaced or word-final U+00B7 as punctuation in Greek text.

tests.sentence: Ο Σωκράτης είπε· «Τι κάνεις σήμερα;»
Η νεράιδα τάισε το παιδί με ρούχα.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Vietnamese spaces separate syllables, NOT words. Multi-syllable compounds (Việt Nam, quốc ngữ, đặc biệt) should ideally be grouped as single clickable tokens. Ensure NFC normalization combines base vowel + circumflex/horn/breve + tone mark into precomposed characters (mostly Latin Extended Additional U+1EA0..U+1EF9, plus Latin-1 and Latin Extended-A/B letters such as à, á, ê, ô, ơ, ư). Note that Đ/đ (U+0110/U+0111) does not decompose in NFD.

tests.sentence: Người Việt Nam nói tiếng Việt rất chuẩn.
Quốc ngữ có chữ Đ và đ đặc biệt.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Polish Ł/ł (U+0141/U+0142) is a stroked letter and does not decompose via NFD diacritic stripping. Preserve all Polish diacritics (ą, ć, ę, ł, ń, ó, ś, ź, ż).

tests.sentence: W Szczebrzeszynie chrząszcz brzmi w trzcinie i żąda źdźbła.
— Czy przeczytałeś już tę książkę za 29,99 zł?

normalization_rules.special_notes: Lowercase ď (U+010F) and ť (U+0165) render their caron (háček) as an apostrophe-like glyph, but they are single Unicode codepoints and must never be split by apostrophe regexes.

tests.sentence: Příliš žluťoučký kůň úpěl ďábelské ódy.
V Chřibech je čistý vzduch.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Normalize legacy cedilla characters Ş/ş (U+015E/U+015F) and Ţ/ţ (U+0162/U+0163) to standard Romanian comma-below Ș/ș (U+0218/U+0219) and Ț/ț (U+021A/U+021B) before dictionary lookup.

tests.sentence: Șapte țânțari și-au găsit adăpost în pădure.
Dânsul mănâncă pâine caldă.

normalization_rules.special_notes: å, ä, and ö are distinct alphabet letters sorted after z, never diacritic variants of a or o.

tests.sentence: Åke äter ärtsoppa på en ö nära Västerås.
Klockan är sju, eller hur?

normalization_rules.special_notes: æ (U+00E6), ø (U+00F8), and å (U+00E5) are distinct letters; note that ø does not decompose in NFD.

tests.sentence: Blåbærgrød på en ø i nærheden af Århus.
Hunden gøede, men katten løb væk.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Preserve æ, ø, å and strip enclitic definite articles (-en, -et, -a, -ene) for lemma lookup.

tests.sentence: Særdeles høye trær står på en øy nær Ålesund.
Kjøkkenet vårt har både melk og brød.

normalization_rules.special_notes: CRITICAL: Convert NFD Conjoining Jamo (U+1100..U+11FF) to NFC Precomposed Hangul Syllables (U+AC00..U+D7AF). Korean spaces separate Eojeol (phrase units = base noun + attached josa particle). Either split the base noun and particle into sub-tokens or keep the Eojeol as one surface token that resolves to [noun_lemma, particle_lemma].

tests.sentence: 선생님께서 학생들에게 한국어 책을 주셨습니다.
책이, 책은, 책도 다 값비싼 옛글이다.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Strip inverted opening punctuation (¿ U+00BF, ¡ U+00A1). De-inflect imperative/gerund/infinitive verbs with attached enclitic pronouns (dámelo -> dar + me + lo) and restore shifted stress accents.

tests.sentence: ¿Cómo estás, niño? ¡Qué vergüenza, cuesta 10.000,50 €!
Dámelo rápido, por favor.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Keep hyphenated mesoclitic and enclitic verb forms (dir-me-á, vê-lo) and hyphenated compounds (guarda-chuva) intact as surface tokens, while resolving mesoclitics to [verb_infinitive, pronoun] in dictionary_lemmas.

tests.sentence: Não me dê explicações: «Ele dir-me-á a verdade amanhã!»
O guarda-chuva custou 1250,99 € na terça-feira.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Strip optional combining acute stress marks (U+0301) used in learner texts, but do NOT strip the breve on й (U+0439) in NFD. Support matching ё (U+0451) to both ё and е in dictionary lookup. Keep hyphenated particles (-то, -либо, -нибудь, кое-, по-) attached.

tests.sentence: — Пойдёмте как-нибудь в кафе «У озера»? — спросил он.
Книга стоит 1 500,50 ₽ в Москве.

normalization_rules.special_notes: CRITICAL: In Ukrainian, the apostrophe (', ’, or U+02BC ʼ) is an internal phonetic hard-sign equivalent (e.g., п'ять, з'їли, м'ясо) and NEVER a clitic boundary. Never split a Ukrainian word on an apostrophe.

tests.sentence: П'ять хлоп'ят з'їли м'ясо в Києві.
Ґанок біля джерела коштує 2 000 грн.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Keep leading apostrophe on archaic genitive markers ('s, 't) and internal apostrophes in contractions (zo'n) or plurals (auto's). When IJ is capitalized at the start of a word (IJsselmeer), both I and J are uppercase.

tests.sentence: 's Morgens zag ik een reëel IJsselmeerschip.
Zo'n auto kost € 25.000,- in België.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Preserve double acute accents ő (U+0151) and ű (U+0171) as distinct from umlauts ö and ü. Keep case suffixes hyphenated onto numbers and symbols (2026-ban, 10%-os) attached.

tests.sentence: Öt szép szűz őrült írót nyúz Győr-Moson-Sopronban.
2026-ban 10%-os növekedés várható.

normalization_rules.special_notes: In Finnish, a colon (:) inside a word attaches a case suffix to an acronym, initialism, or number (e.g., EU:ssa, 2:een). Never split a token on an internal colon when followed by letters.

tests.sentence: Hän on kotoisin Yli-Iistä ja käy EU:ssa.
Epäjärjestelmällistyttämättömyydellänsäkäänköhän hän pärjää?

normalization_rules.special_notes: Preserve õ (U+00F5), ä, ö, ü, š, ž. Keep hyphenated compounds (jää-äär) and case suffixes attached to acronyms via hyphen or apostrophe (NATO-sse).

tests.sentence: Jõgeva ööbik laulab jää-äärel.
NATO-sse kuulub palju riike.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Preserve Lithuanian ogonek vowels (ą, ę, į, ų), overdot (ė U+0117), macron (ū U+016B), and carons (č, š, ž). If learner texts include pitch-accent diacritics (grave, acute, tilde on i/j), use lt-LT locale casing to avoid stray combining dots (U+0307).

tests.sentence: Ąžuolas, eglė ir įvairūs žiedai žydi žemėje.
Jis turi 1 000,00 € sąskaitoje.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Preserve Latvian palatalized consonants Ģ/ģ (U+0122/U+0123), Ķ/ķ (U+0136/U+0137), Ļ/ļ (U+013B/U+013C), Ņ/ņ (U+0145/U+0146) and macron vowels (ā, ē, ī, ū).

tests.sentence: Ķegumā un Ģikšos aug ļoti zaļi koki.
Mārtiņš ēd saldējumu.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Normalize legacy single-codepoint titlecase/compatibility digraphs (Ǆ, ǅ, ǆ, Ǉ, ǈ, ǉ, Ǌ, ǋ, ǌ U+01C4..U+01CC) via NFKC or explicit mapping to standard two-character sequences (Dž, Lj, Nj) while preserving Đ/đ (U+0110/U+0111).

tests.sentence: Đuro i Ljiljana jedu ćevapčiće u Đakovu.
Knjiga košta 19,99 € u Zagrebu.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Serbian is fully digraphic (Cyrillic and Latin). Cyrillic→Latin mapping is deterministic (Ђ→Đ, Ј→J, Љ→Lj, Њ→Nj, Ћ→Ć, Џ→Dž), but Latin→Cyrillic is not, because nj, lj and dž can be two separate letters (e.g., konjugacija → конјугација). Key the dictionary index on the Latin form (or use a dictionary-backed reverse mapping) so a single index serves both scripts.

tests.sentence: Ђорђе и Љиљана пију кафу у Нишу.
Đorđe i Ljiljana piju kafu u Nišu.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Keep Slovak caron letters ľ/Ľ (U+013E/U+013D), ď/Ď, ť/Ť intact (their caron glyph resembles an apostrophe but is part of the codepoint). Preserve ô (U+00F4) and syllabic consonants ŕ (U+0155), ĺ (U+013A).

tests.sentence: Guľôčka, vŕba a kôň sú v ľadovom lese.
Detský vlak ide rýchlo.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Preserve č, š, ž and handle Slovenian dual grammatical number inflections (1st-person dual -va, 2nd/3rd-person dual -ta, and the dual forms sva/sta of biti) during lemmatization. Do not split sentences on periods inside numeric times (14.30).

tests.sentence: Hišni ljubljenček spi na žolti preprogi.
Ali greva v Ljubljano ob 14.30?

normalization_rules.special_notes: Preserve accented pronoun ѝ (U+045D, 'her' dative clitic) as distinct from conjunction и (U+0438, 'and') and semivowel й (U+0439). Keep hyphenated comparative/superlative prefixes (по-, най-) attached to adjectives/adverbs.

tests.sentence: Пътят към ъгъла е дълъг и тесен.
Тя ѝ каза да дойде по-рано.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Keep hyphenated reduplications (anak-anak, berjalan-jalan) intact as surface tokens, and strip circumfixes/prefixes/reduplication to resolve to the root lemma (anak, jalan). Separate unspaced currency symbol Rp from numbers.

tests.sentence: Anak-anak itu berjalan-jalan di sekitar rumah-rumah tua.
Mereka membeli buku seharga Rp150.000,00.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Keep rhythmic/phonetic reduplications (kuih-muih, kanak-kanak) intact as surface tokens. Separate unspaced currency prefix RM from following digits.

tests.sentence: Kanak-kanak itu berlari-lari sambil makan kuih-muih.
Harga baju di Kuala Lumpur ialah RM50.00.

normalization_rules.special_notes: CRITICAL: Never split on the apostrophe in the Swahili velar nasal digraph ng' (e.g., ng'ombe 'cow', ng'ambo 'abroad'). For agglutinated Bantu verb complexes (ninakupenda = ni-na-ku-penda), keep the full word as the surface token and extract the verb root (-penda) for dictionary_lemmas.

tests.sentence: Ng'ombe wa mwalimu anakula nyasi nyingi.
Ninakupenda na nitakusaidia kesho.

normalization_rules.special_notes: Normalize curly apostrophes (’ U+2019) to ASCII ('). Keep contractions (isn't, they'd've), surname apostrophes (O'Connor), multi-hyphenated modifiers (state-of-the-art), and abbreviations with periods (Dr., U.S.A.) intact, while splitting unspaced em-dashes (—).

tests.sentence: “Isn’t that a state-of-the-art, $10,000.50 system?” asked Dr. O’Connor—smiling.
They'd've bought 3.5 kg of rock 'n' roll records in the U.S.A.
